description: wms.mapama.gob.es: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. Coverage: the area served by wms.mapama.gob.es. The listing groups 19 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Depuradoras de aguas residuales (Q2009.; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Depuradoras de aguas residuales (Q2011.; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Depuradoras de aguas residuales (Q2021.; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Puntos de vertido de depuradoras urbana. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
